study_identification_part.si4_title: Analyzing heterogeneity in Alzheimer disease using multimodal normative modeling on imaging-based ATN biomarkers

cm1_research_objectives.reason: The study clearly states objectives and the purpose of applying normative modeling. It aims to identify individual neuroanatomical and neuropathological variation using a deep learning-based normative model, quantify heterogeneity, derive a disease severity index (DSI), and relate it to dementia severity, cognition, and progression. This satisfies: (1) explicit research questions/objectives; (2) explicit purpose of normative modeling for precision characterization and potential clinical utility.
cm1_research_objectives.supporting_text: Our main objectives can be summarized as follows: (i) assess the extent of neuroanatomical and neuropathological variability ... (iii) estimate a disease severity index (DSI) ... (iv) examine whether the DSI is related to severity of dementia, impaired cognition, and risk of disease progression.
